facts.fact: RobotsMali AI4D Lab in Bamako released 612 hours of transcribed Bambara speech, fine-tuned ASR models (Parakeet and QuartzNet based, deployed in the An Be Kalan app) and the 45-recording Nyana-Eval benchmark, as part of African Next Voices.
